changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Create the Virology lab unit and assign Virology roles to the lab unit
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO lab_unit (id, name, description, is_active, created_date, lastupdated) SELECT NEXTVAL('lab_unit_seq'), 'Virology Laboratory', 'Laboratory unit specializing in viral testing, culture, and molecular diagnostics', true, now(), now() WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lab_unit WHERE name = 'Virology Laboratory' );

INSERT INTO lab_unit_role (id, lab_unit_id, system_role_id, active, created_date, lastupdated) SELECT NEXTVAL('lab_unit_role_seq'), (SELECT id FROM lab_unit WHERE name = 'Virology Laboratory'), sr.id, true, now(), now() FROM system_role sr WHERE sr.name IN ( 'Virology Lab Technician', 'Virology Microbiologist', 'Virology Manager', 'Virology Principal Investigator', 'Virology Data Manager' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lab_unit_role lur JOIN lab_unit lu ON lur.lab_unit_id = lu.id WHERE lu.name = 'Virology Laboratory' AND lur.system_role_id = sr.id );
